channel.title: AI Threat Watch: QA
channel.description: Verified case files located in QA.

item.title: [MEDIUM] QatarEnergy repeats warning over AI-generated videos impersonating it in investment scams
item.description: QatarEnergy reissued a warning that fraudulent online investment schemes were using its name and logo, including AI-generated videos impersonating the company, and stressed it never solicits money from the public. Target: QatarEnergy and Qatari public. QA. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [LOW] QatarEnergy warns public of AI-generated videos impersonating it to sell fake investments
item.description: Qatar's state energy company warned about fake adverts and AI-generated videos presenting investment opportunities in its name, stressing it never asks the public for money; it reissued the warning in November 2025. Target: QatarEnergy brand and Gulf investors. QA. Verification: confirmed.
